# The support you deserve from an ally you can trust.

Alliance is your guide to health care services that help you live your best life.

[ Get Started ][47]

## Healthcare doesn't have to be complicated.

Alliance is proud to offer a comprehensive list of services for every age and ability to simplify
the process of finding and coordinating the varying supports you need.

### CFSS Support

 Flexible, self-directed options to meet your needs.

[ Learn more ][48]

### Consultation Services

Helping you understand the new CFSS program.

[ Learn more ][49]

### Financial Management

Flexibility and control to customize your care.

[ Learn more ][50]

### 245D Licensed Support

Individualized support in your home and community.

[ Learn more ][51]

### Mental Health

A variety of support services and therapy to help you flourish.

[ Learn more ][52]

### Medical Supply

Find equipment and supplies tailored to your needs.

[ Learn more ][53]

### Home Health

Care for your everyday needs in the comfort of your home.

[ Learn more ][54]

## Alliance Health Care builds bridges between people and the services they need.

Healthcare options can be a confusing maze that keeps people from finding the services and supports
they need. We believe something as essential as healthcare shouldn’t be hard, which is why we bring
together a thorough knowledge of the healthcare system and comprehensive services to deliver
high-quality individualized care.

Person-Centered

We recognize the inherent worth of every human being. Therefore, we believe that quality healthcare
is each person’s right, no matter who they are or what support they need. We build options that
start with the kind of life each person wants to live, and tailor our service delivery to meet those
desires.

Accessibility

Removing barriers and providing equal access to healthcare is an essential mission of Alliance.  We
offer our comprehensive list of services in all communities and strive to support your needs, no
matter how complex or varied they might be. 

Competence

Alliance started when our owner needed support at home for her daughter with Down Syndrome.  Our
personal experience, coupled with over three decades in the healthcare industry, gives us a unique
combination of both empathy and expertise.  We keep your perspective in mind when working with you
to provide personalized services that make sense for your life. 

Advocacy

Alliance is involved in many community and state initiatives to develop best practices and advocate
for increased support to the aging, disability, and mental health communities.  We listen to our
clients' individual needs and preferences and connect them to available resources, services, and
supports.

Inclusion

"We're the same. We're different. That's what makes the world such fun." ~ Sesame Street

Alliance recognizes and honors the uniqueness of every individual. We foster a culture of
inclusivity by providing healthcare services and employment opportunities that respects the needs
and preferences of each person’s culture, class, age, ability, and socioeconomic background, without
discrimination. 

[ Get Started ][55]

## Let's keep things simple.

Alliance is your guide to finding the right care that works for you. 

When you partner with Alliance, we strive to handle all of your healthcare needs, no matter how
complex or varied they might be.

[ Get Started ][56]

[Have a question?][57]

Alliance offers CFSS, Consultation Services, Financial Management (FMS), Mental Health, 245D
Licensed Support, Medical Supply, and Home Health services throughout the state of Minnesota.

# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

## Insights

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]

# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

## Insights

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]

### View transcript

Having 1 kid?...Not exactly simple.

Having 6 kids? Definitely not simple. Wait, that’s 8 people in one family. Whoa.

That means finding ONE tv show they’ll ALL watch.

Making ONE dinner they’ll ALL eat.

And how do you play a board game with 6 kids?…actually, that’s kinda simple.

Okaaay, not so simple.

But it’s not just tantrums.

It’s attitudes.

That’s right. Teenagers.

And how do you decide who gets the last piece of pizza?

But you don’t just have 6 kids, you have 6 kids all with chronic illnesses.

That means on top of it all, you have to manage over 50 prescriptions, medical checkups, and support
everyone’s mental health.

Luckily, you’re not alone…I mean Tricia, obviously YOU’RE not alone.

But you’ve also got CVS Health as your healthcare partner, to manage specialty medications, provide
walk-in appointments, and keep track of it all in the CVS Health app.

So, does that make everything…simple?

No. It makes it simple…er

And sometimes, “simpler” is all you need to live a little happier and healthier.

But who gets the last piece of pizza? That’s still your call.

When you need more than a pharmacy…
CVS Health.
Healthier Happens Together.

Having 1 kid?...Not exactly simple.

Having 6 kids? Definitely not simple. Wait, that’s 8 people in one family. Whoa.

That means finding ONE tv show they’ll ALL watch.

Making ONE dinner they’ll ALL eat.

And how do you play a board game with 6 kids?…actually, that’s kinda simple.

Okaaay, not so simple.

But it’s not just tantrums.

It’s attitudes.

That’s right. Teenagers.

And how do you decide who gets the last piece of pizza?

But you don’t just have 6 kids, you have 6 kids all with chronic illnesses.

That means on top of it all, you have to manage over 50 prescriptions, medical checkups, and support
everyone’s mental health.

Luckily, you’re not alone…I mean Tricia, obviously YOU’RE not alone.

But you’ve also got CVS Health as your healthcare partner, to manage specialty medications, provide
walk-in appointments, and keep track of it all in the CVS Health app.

So, does that make everything…simple?

No. It makes it simple…er

And sometimes, “simpler” is all you need to live a little happier and healthier.

But who gets the last piece of pizza? That’s still your call.

When you need more than a pharmacy…
CVS Health.
Healthier Happens Together.

    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]

  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

operational and R&D excellence.”

Our strategy

curative medicines.

Welcome to Cencora

# Find solutions that pave a reliable path to patients

Explore our full range of solutions designed to help you bring innovations to market and improve
care delivery worldwide.
[ Explore our solutions ][90]
[A light-skinned person wearing a white track jacket and a bright t-shirt jogging through a park
with the morning sun shining behind their head.]

## Distribution, commercialization, patient access, and pharmacy solutions for manufacturers,
## providers, and health systems.

We combine global capabilities and local expertise to help healthcare professionals bring
life-saving therapies, preventive treatments, and high-quality care to communities around the world.

[Logistics and warehousing][91] **

Leverage our global network to ensure safe, secure storage and timely delivery worldwide.

[ Drug research and clinical development support ][92] **

Streamline the drug development process and minimize go-to-market risk.

[ Commercialization support ][93] **

Build a foundation for a successful product launch and accelerate your speed-to-market.

[ Patient access and adherence support ][94] **

Address barriers to patient access and increase your product's speed-to-therapy.

[ Wholesale and specialty distribution ][95] **

Increase access to medications with our innovative solutions and secure supply chain.

[ Provider solutions ][96] **

Elevate the patient experience and expand care possibilities with physician practice solutions.

[ Pharmacy solutions ][97] **

Build and scale your pharmacy, accelerate growth, and deliver stronger clinical results.

[ Hospital and health system solutions ][98] **

Solve critical problems, plan for sustainable growth, and create better health outcomes.

[ Explore our capabilities ][99]

## Why Cencora

The end-to-end support we provide across the entire healthcare spectrum isn’t the only thing that
sets Cencora apart. There are so many other ways we provide a differentiated experience when you tap
into our unique capabilities.

### Global reach with local expertise

With a presence in over 50 countries, we’re expanding access to care worldwide, while our
community-level insight helps us to deploy resources effectively and efficiently.
[ Learn more about our global reach ][100]

### A commitment to innovation

Together with our industry partners, we’re continuously innovating to meet the needs of our
customers, evolving our solutions, and reshaping how healthcare is delivered.
[ Learn more about our innovation commitment ][101]

### A partner-centric  approach

We work closely with pharma companies and care providers every day, listening to their challenges
and using their insights to develop solutions that will have a positive impact on their patients.
[ Learn more about us ][102]

## What is Cencora?

It’s not easy to fully understand everything Cencora does. With countless solutions and services for
manufacturers, health systems, government entities, physician practices, pharmacies, and more, it’s
practically impossible for us to summarize what we offer without sacrificing some very important
details.

Watch this video to see some of our team members trying to define Cencora, and then check out our
stories to gain deeper insight into our business, our purpose, and our impact.
[ Explore all of our stories ][103]

## Get started with CVS Specialty®

### Discover all the ways we support your health

Say hello to a different kind of specialty pharmacy that does more than simply provide your
medication. We surround you with easy-to-use services to help you manage your health, plus a highly
trained CareTeam to offer guidance and answer questions.

[Learn how to get started ][63]

## Manage your CVS Specialty medications

Refill prescriptions Get your medication Check order status Manage payments Contact CareTeam

### Refill online in minutes

In just a few steps, you can refill your prescriptions online –– and in a secure manner –– through
our website or our CVS Specialty app. Plus, you can sign up for refill reminders that are sent by
text and/or email.

[Learn how to refill online ][64]

### Deliver to your door or pick up in store

Get the medication you need, where you need it. Choose home delivery and your medication will arrive
at your door, anywhere nationwide. Or pick it up at any CVS Pharmacy® — [the choice is yours.][65]*

[Explore convenient options ][66]

### Track orders from start to finish

Sign in anytime on your computer or mobile device to check your prescription order status. See when
your refill is processing, when it’s shipped and when it’s been delivered. You can also get status
alerts [by email or text message][67].*

[Check your order status ][68]

### Make and view payments

Managing your health care bills shouldn’t be complicated. With the CVS Specialty website and mobile
app, you can make payments in just a few simple steps.

[Make a payment ][69]

### Contact us by chat or phone

Connect to a dedicated CareTeam led by nurses and pharmacists specially trained in your condition.
They’re available weekdays 8 AM to 9 PM ET and weekends 9 AM to 6 PM ET. Ask about your medication,
insurance and more!

[Reach out to your CareTeam ][70]

## Get started with CVS Specialty®

### Discover all the ways we support your health

Say hello to a different kind of specialty pharmacy that does more than simply provide your
medication. We surround you with easy-to-use services to help you manage your health, plus a highly
trained CareTeam to offer guidance and answer questions.

[Learn how to get started ][63]

## Manage your CVS Specialty medications

Refill prescriptions Get your medication Check order status Manage payments Contact CareTeam

### Refill online in minutes

In just a few steps, you can refill your prescriptions online –– and in a secure manner –– through
our website or our CVS Specialty app. Plus, you can sign up for refill reminders that are sent by
text and/or email.

[Learn how to refill online ][64]

### Deliver to your door or pick up in store

Get the medication you need, where you need it. Choose home delivery and your medication will arrive
at your door, anywhere nationwide. Or pick it up at any CVS Pharmacy® — [the choice is yours.][65]*

[Explore convenient options ][66]

### Track orders from start to finish

Sign in anytime on your computer or mobile device to check your prescription order status. See when
your refill is processing, when it’s shipped and when it’s been delivered. You can also get status
alerts [by email or text message][67].*

[Check your order status ][68]

### Make and view payments

Managing your health care bills shouldn’t be complicated. With the CVS Specialty website and mobile
app, you can make payments in just a few simple steps.

[Make a payment ][69]

### Contact us by chat or phone

Connect to a dedicated CareTeam led by nurses and pharmacists specially trained in your condition.
They’re available weekdays 8 AM to 9 PM ET and weekends 9 AM to 6 PM ET. Ask about your medication,
insurance and more!

[Reach out to your CareTeam ][70]

## Know what to expect with Coram® CVS Specialty Infusion Services (Coram)

Stay informed about what to expect with your therapy at every step. Our patient guides, educational
resources and self-service options make it easier for you to take control of your health at home or
on the go.

[Get started with Coram ][71]

# CVS Specialty CareTeam

Available weekdays 8 AM to 9 PM ET and weekends 9 AM to 6 PM ET.

[Chat or call us ][72]

Call our 24/7 support team to get answers to your questions throughout your treatment.
 

[Call us ][73]

### Hjälper mammor och barn från graviditet till födsel.

På Ferring arbetar vi för att hjälpa blivande föräldrar och att hålla mammor och barn friska och
hälsosamma – hela vägen genom graviditet och födsel. Mer än en tredjedel av våra investeringar inom
forskning och utveckling går till att ta fram innovativa behandlingar inom reproduktion och
kvinnohälsa. Vi arbetar även aktivt inom gastroenterologi och urologi.

### Forskning & Innovation

Var och en av oss på Ferring bidrar till att tillhandahålla innovativa lösningar för att hjälpa
människor. Vi gör stora forsknings- och utvecklingsinvesteringar inom nya terapiområden och
utvecklar lösningar för framtidens hälso- och sjukvård.

### Arbeta på Ferring

På Ferring Pharmaceuticals värdesätter vi en arbetsmiljö som motiverar våra anställda samt
stimulerar kreativa förmågor och initiativ. Med cirka 7000 anställda i över 50 länder, är vi stolta
över vår mångkulturella miljö.

[icon box image]

### Att hjälpa människor

Ferring är ett forskningsdrivet läkemedelsföretag som arbetar för att hjälpa människor bilda familj
och leva ett bättre liv. Ferring är ledande inom reproduktionsmedicin och mödrahälsa samt är
verksamma inom gastroenterologi och urologi.

På Ferring har vi åtagit oss att bygga familjer över hela världen och hjälpa människor att leva
bättre liv. Vi är ledande inom reproduktionsmedicin och mödrahälsa, gastroenterologi och urologi.

**Review Latest Developments in **the field of Infertility, Embryology, Andrology, Obstetrics and
Gynaecology.****

**Print ISSN : 2394-4285 | Online ISSN : 2468-919X**

The Fertility Science and Research (FSR) is an open access peer-reviewed journal committed to
publishing high-quality articles in the field of Infertility, Embryology, Andrology, Obstetrics and
Gynaecology.

# See what your competitors

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data

## Trusted by teams at

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone

#### LOGISTICS MANAGEMENT

Since 1983, Genesis Logistics has excelled in third party logistics management and transportation
forwarder services for companies ranging from entrepreneurs to Fortune 500s. Today, we remain
privately held, with more than 100 employees in 5 locations across the USA. As a solution-driven
company, our ability to tailor our service offering to the needs of our customers differentiates us.

Every month, the logistics experts at Genesis deliver thousands of shipments to field
representatives and distributors, ranging from product samples and marketing literature to
promotional items, fixtures, displays, books and just about anything else you can imagine. Reliable
distribution management is a cornerstone of our services and a key to our
legacy of success.

the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This

corporate social responsibility program.

In 1932, at the height of the Depression, a pharmacist named Henry Schein started our company with
the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This

corporate social responsibility program.

# LineageOS Android Distribution

A free and open-source operating system for various devices, based on the Android mobile platform.

[Get LineageOS][9] [Blog][10]
[Home]

## Latest news

### [Summertime Updates!][11]

###### Exciting changes of all shapes and sizes are on their way!

calendar_today July 07, 2026 person_outline Inhishonor and Nolen Johnson

[A color wheel on top of several alternating squareblocks containing various images]

## Individuality

Customization is paramount to productivity.
That’s why LineageOS promises to push for user personalization and preference.

Everyone is unique and your device should be too.

[Two overlapping abstract screens, the left showing a Trust protocol notification and the right
showing a PIN input being scrambled to protect against memorization]

## Security

Your data, your rules. Along with monthly security updates to every supported device, we enhance
existing privacy touchpoints around the OS and keep you informed of how the system shares your data.


Trust helps you understand the state of your device's security and warns you about possible threats.

[A pinwheel of four devices each showing Lineage wallpapers]

## Longevity

LineageOS extends the functionality and lifespan of mobile devices from more than 20 different
manufacturers thanks to our open-source community of contributors from all around the world.

Want to contribute? [See how you can make LineageOS better][12].

[The LineageOS core app icons organized in a grid]

## Power to you

Our open-source apps are here to help you get through the day.

Want to do more with your device?
Power users will enjoy Unix command-line utilities.
Android developers will turn any device into the perfect device for apps development thanks to
enhanced tools and debugging capabilities.

## Ready? Get LineageOS now!

LineageOS, an open-source Android distribution, is available for several devices,
with more being continuously added thanks to the biggest, yet ever growing, Android open-source
community.
Join us and breathe new life in your device, be it old or new.

[Find your device][13]

Everyone is unique and your device should be too.

[Two overlapping abstract screens, the left showing a Trust protocol notification and the right
showing a PIN input being scrambled to protect against memorization]

## Security

Your data, your rules. Along with monthly security updates to every supported device, we enhance
existing privacy touchpoints around the OS and keep you informed of how the system shares your data.


Trust helps you understand the state of your device's security and warns you about possible threats.

[A pinwheel of four devices each showing Lineage wallpapers]

## Longevity

LineageOS extends the functionality and lifespan of mobile devices from more than 20 different
manufacturers thanks to our open-source community of contributors from all around the world.

Want to contribute? [See how you can make LineageOS better][12].

[The LineageOS core app icons organized in a grid]

## Power to you

Our open-source apps are here to help you get through the day.

Want to do more with your device?
Power users will enjoy Unix command-line utilities.
Android developers will turn any device into the perfect device for apps development thanks to
enhanced tools and debugging capabilities.

## Ready? Get LineageOS now!

LineageOS, an open-source Android distribution, is available for several devices,
with more being continuously added thanks to the biggest, yet ever growing, Android open-source
community.
Join us and breathe new life in your device, be it old or new.

  Your had been making a fantastic work in the several publications, the time in send us the

  I have collaborated with AOVS over the last 2 years. Their professional and courteous approach

  Hematology & Transfusion International Journal is doing an excellent job with publishing excellent

  You will find in this journal valuable and original articles to keep pace with current research in

Our focus is on developing cleanroom and high-containment solutions that ensure the safety of
healthcare providers, patients, and their loved ones. We understand the significance of maintaining
health through preventive measures, accurate diagnosis, and effective treatment, and therefore, we
aim to offer reliable products that support this essential service.

Our commitment to continuous research and development has earned PBSC an excellent reputation as the
premier supplier of safe, accurate, and high-quality products. We have successfully installed our
solutions within healthcare across the globe, making us a trusted partner in the industry.

[View Healthcare Solutions][38]

Given the potential risks posed by high containment facilities to both human life and the global
economy, it is crucial to prioritise measures that ensure high containment protection. These
facilities are crucial in preventing, detecting, and responding to threats to global health
security. Our solutions are designed and rigorously tested to meet the highest levels of safety.
They have a proven track record in many leading BSL3 and BSL4 institutes and exceed the most
rigorous testing criteria to ensure containment control.

The extensive range of products provides outstanding functionality to suit all high containment and
cleanroom facilities, with sleek aesthetic designs to complement any installation.

[View High Containment Solutions][39]

Medical research involves the application of scientific principles to expand our knowledge in the
field of medicine and to develop new drugs and medical products. PBSC is committed to delivering and
improving our products to help research personnel maintain accurate research trials. Our products
can be customised to fit standard or bespoke requirements and installed in a manner of different
wall types.

The wide choice of cleanroom, high containment, and decontamination products are specifically
designed to minimise the risk of contamination within the extensive array of research facility
settings.

[View Medical Research Solutions][40]

drugs that are used as medications to cure and prevent diseases. Our hygienic, reliable, and highly

Our focus is on developing cleanroom and high-containment solutions that ensure the safety of
healthcare providers, patients, and their loved ones. We understand the significance of maintaining
health through preventive measures, accurate diagnosis, and effective treatment, and therefore, we
aim to offer reliable products that support this essential service.

Our commitment to continuous research and development has earned PBSC an excellent reputation as the
premier supplier of safe, accurate, and high-quality products. We have successfully installed our
solutions within healthcare across the globe, making us a trusted partner in the industry.

[View Healthcare Solutions][38]

Given the potential risks posed by high containment facilities to both human life and the global
economy, it is crucial to prioritise measures that ensure high containment protection. These
facilities are crucial in preventing, detecting, and responding to threats to global health
security. Our solutions are designed and rigorously tested to meet the highest levels of safety.
They have a proven track record in many leading BSL3 and BSL4 institutes and exceed the most
rigorous testing criteria to ensure containment control.

The extensive range of products provides outstanding functionality to suit all high containment and
cleanroom facilities, with sleek aesthetic designs to complement any installation.

[View High Containment Solutions][39]

Medical research involves the application of scientific principles to expand our knowledge in the
field of medicine and to develop new drugs and medical products. PBSC is committed to delivering and
improving our products to help research personnel maintain accurate research trials. Our products
can be customised to fit standard or bespoke requirements and installed in a manner of different
wall types.

The wide choice of cleanroom, high containment, and decontamination products are specifically
designed to minimise the risk of contamination within the extensive array of research facility
settings.

[View Medical Research Solutions][40]

The pharmaceutical industry is responsible for discovering, developing, producing, and marketing
drugs that are used as medications to cure and prevent diseases. Our hygienic, reliable, and highly
functional solutions are used globally in the pharmaceutical industry, contributing to facilities
with state-of-the-art equipment.

With specifically designed products for pharma applications with clean flush designs and minimal
visible fixings. A leading provider of H202 decontamination chambers for many blue-chip companies,
offering exceptional quality and performance.

[View Pharmaceutical Solutions][41]

PBSC offers an extensive after-sales support service, including planned preventative maintenance
programs, servicing, and spare parts.

Placing a high priority on the maintenance and upkeep of our products, Achieving this via the supply
of approved spare parts and regular serving.

### **О журнале**

«Фарматека» – рецензируемый научно-практический медицинский журнал, адресованный терапевтам,
педиатрам, кардиологам, эндокринологам, гастроэнтерологам, пульмонологам, дерматологам,
акушерам-гинекологам, урологам, онкологам, неврологам, ревматологам и врачам других специальностей.

Журнал «Фарматека» издается с 1994 года Начиная с первых номеров журнала на его страницах
публикуется информация о современных лекарственных средствах, их терапевтическом действии,
фармакокинетике и фармакодинамике, побочных эффектах, предназначенная для практикующих врачей;
освещаются последние достижения медицинской науки и техники, значимые клинические исследования
лекарственных средств, итоги международных и российских конгрессов и конференций.

С 2002 по 2017 год редакционный совет возглавлял член-корр. РАМН Юрий Борисович Белоусов, в совет
вошел ряд ведущих российских специалистов. Читательский круг журнала расширяется – издание читают
практикующие врачи, руководители медицинских учреждений и ВУЗов, НИИ, заведующие кафедрами, студенты
и соискатели.

В состав Редакционной коллегии журнала «Фарматека» входят ведущие российские специалисты основных
областей клинической медицины – 64 докторов медицинских наук. Все они принимают активное участие в
создании журнала и подтвердили согласие на вхождение в Редакционный совет.

Все номера журнала тематические и посвящены отдельным областям клинической медицины. Журнал выходит
с периодичностью 10 номеров в год. Объем полноцветного номера в среднем составляет 160–280 полос.
Тираж журнала превышает 25 тыс. экземпляров. Тираж сертифицирован Национальной тиражной службой.
Журнал «Фарматека» рассылается по подписке, распространяется на всех медицинских конгрессах, съездах
и конференциях на территории РФ, а также на обучающих циклах для врачей и студентов.

Журнал выпускается по следующим основным тематикам: Оториноларингология, Акушерство и гинекология,
Онкология, лучевая терапия, Урология и андрология, Внутренние болезни, Эндокринология, Кардиология,
Педиатрия, Инфекционные болезни, Дерматовенерология, Неврология, Ревматология, Пульмонология,
Восстановительная медицина, спортивная медицина, лечебная физкультура, курортология и физиотерапия,
Фармакология, клиническая фармакология. В журнале «Фарматека» публикуются оригинальные статьи,
клинические разборы, обзоры и лекции, посвященные наиболее актуальным проблемам фармакотерапии,
подготовленные ведущими специалистами соответствующих областей медицины.

Журнал «Фарматека» призван предоставлять читателям – широкому кругу врачей и научных медицинских
работников – наиболее актуальную информацию о результатах клинических исследований и новых, в т.ч.
инновационных, методах диагностики и лечения.

Журнал входит в перечень изданий, рекомендованных Высшей аттестационной комиссией (ВАК).

Ежегодно в рамках журнала «Фарматека» под редакцией М.Б. Анциферова - Главный внештатный специалист
эндокринолог Департамента здравоохранения города Москвы, главный врач ГБУЗ «Эндокринологический
диспансер Департамента здравоохранения города Москвы», доктор медицинских наук, профессор,
выпускается сборник избранных научных статей по эндокринологии «Современные аспекты фармакотерапии
эндокринных заболеваний». Сборник приурочен к Московскому городскому съезду эндокринологов.

С 2020 г. по настоящее время главный редактор Сычев Дмитрий Алексеевич

### **О журнале**

«Фарматека» – рецензируемый научно-практический медицинский журнал, адресованный терапевтам,
педиатрам, кардиологам, эндокринологам, гастроэнтерологам, пульмонологам, дерматологам,
акушерам-гинекологам, урологам, онкологам, неврологам, ревматологам и врачам других специальностей.

Журнал «Фарматека» издается с 1994 года Начиная с первых номеров журнала на его страницах
публикуется информация о современных лекарственных средствах, их терапевтическом действии,
фармакокинетике и фармакодинамике, побочных эффектах, предназначенная для практикующих врачей;
освещаются последние достижения медицинской науки и техники, значимые клинические исследования
лекарственных средств, итоги международных и российских конгрессов и конференций.

С 2002 по 2017 год редакционный совет возглавлял член-корр. РАМН Юрий Борисович Белоусов, в совет
вошел ряд ведущих российских специалистов. Читательский круг журнала расширяется – издание читают
практикующие врачи, руководители медицинских учреждений и ВУЗов, НИИ, заведующие кафедрами, студенты
и соискатели.

В состав Редакционной коллегии журнала «Фарматека» входят ведущие российские специалисты основных
областей клинической медицины – 64 докторов медицинских наук. Все они принимают активное участие в
создании журнала и подтвердили согласие на вхождение в Редакционный совет.

Все номера журнала тематические и посвящены отдельным областям клинической медицины. Журнал выходит
с периодичностью 10 номеров в год. Объем полноцветного номера в среднем составляет 160–280 полос.
Тираж журнала превышает 25 тыс. экземпляров. Тираж сертифицирован Национальной тиражной службой.
Журнал «Фарматека» рассылается по подписке, распространяется на всех медицинских конгрессах, съездах
и конференциях на территории РФ, а также на обучающих циклах для врачей и студентов.

Журнал выпускается по следующим основным тематикам: Оториноларингология, Акушерство и гинекология,
Онкология, лучевая терапия, Урология и андрология, Внутренние болезни, Эндокринология, Кардиология,
Педиатрия, Инфекционные болезни, Дерматовенерология, Неврология, Ревматология, Пульмонология,
Восстановительная медицина, спортивная медицина, лечебная физкультура, курортология и физиотерапия,
Фармакология, клиническая фармакология. В журнале «Фарматека» публикуются оригинальные статьи,
клинические разборы, обзоры и лекции, посвященные наиболее актуальным проблемам фармакотерапии,
подготовленные ведущими специалистами соответствующих областей медицины.

Журнал «Фарматека» призван предоставлять читателям – широкому кругу врачей и научных медицинских
работников – наиболее актуальную информацию о результатах клинических исследований и новых, в т.ч.
инновационных, методах диагностики и лечения.

Журнал входит в перечень изданий, рекомендованных Высшей аттестационной комиссией (ВАК).

Ежегодно в рамках журнала «Фарматека» под редакцией М.Б. Анциферова - Главный внештатный специалист
эндокринолог Департамента здравоохранения города Москвы, главный врач ГБУЗ «Эндокринологический
диспансер Департамента здравоохранения города Москвы», доктор медицинских наук, профессор,
выпускается сборник избранных научных статей по эндокринологии «Современные аспекты фармакотерапии
эндокринных заболеваний». Сборник приурочен к Московскому городскому съезду эндокринологов.

С 2020 г. по настоящее время главный редактор Сычев Дмитрий Алексеевич

# Home

**Transfeminine Science** is a resource for original informational content on the subject of
[transfeminine hormone therapy][11]. This form of [hormone therapy][12] is also known variously as
feminizing hormone therapy (FHT), gender-affirming hormone therapy (GAHT) for [transfeminine][13]
people, and, more in the past, male-to-female (MtF) hormone replacement therapy (HRT). It involves
the use of female [sex hormones][14] including [estrogens][15] and [progestogens][16], as well as
[androgen][17]-opposing medications known as [antiandrogens][18], to produce [feminization][19],
[demasculinization][20], alleviation of [gender dysphoria][21], and other changes in [transgender
women][22] and [non-binary transfeminine individuals][23].

Transfeminine Science was created by [Aly][24] and contains articles by different writers on
transfeminine hormone therapy. Our authors and other information are listed on our **[About][25]**
page. The content on this site is written by transgender people, for transgender people, as well as
for medical providers and academics in transgender health. A categorized listing of articles on
Transfeminine Science can be found on the **[Articles][26]** page, while a listing of articles by
date can be found on the **[Latest][27]** page. The **[Misc][28]** page contains other content like
[useful tools][29], [notable publications][30], and [links][31]. The articles on this site are
[wiki][32]-esque [living documents][33], and hence may be updated, expanded, and improved over time.

### Where does Universal Drugstore ship to, and how long does delivery take?

We ship to all destinations within the United States (including Alaska and Hawaii), as well as
internationally. Orders over $100 shipping within the U.S. qualify for free shipping; orders under
$100 have a flat $7 USD shipping fee. International orders outside the U.S. have a flat-rate
shipping fee of $19.95 USD.

Estimated delivery times are approximately 2 weeks for U.S. and Canada, and approximately 4 weeks
for international orders. Delivery times may vary based on location, customs clearance, and other
factors beyond our control.

### Is a prescription required to order medications on Universal Drugstore?

At Universal Drugstore, you’ll need to provide a valid prescription from a licensed medical
professional to purchase prescription medications. Our pharmacy team carefully verifies all
prescriptions before processing any orders. If you have questions about your prescription, feel free
to reach out to our customer support team, and we’ll guide you through the process.

### How do I submit my prescription on Universal Drugstore?

To submit your prescription at Universal Drugstore, simply upload it securely during checkout or
email it to our dedicated prescription service. Our licensed pharmacists will review and validate
the prescription before fulfilling your order.

### What payment methods are accepted by Universal Drugstore?

Universal Drugstore accepts a variety of secure payment options to make ordering prescriptions safe
and convenient. We currently accept Visa, Mastercard, international money orders, and eChecks
(electronic checks).

An eCheck, or electronic check, allows you to pay directly from your bank account through a secure
digital process. This method is facilitated via the Automated Clearing House (ACH) network, offering
a reliable alternative to traditional paper checks.

All transactions are processed securely, and our team is here to support you in choosing the best
payment method for your needs.

### How do I place a refill order on Universal Drugstore?

You can log in to your account on the pharmacy's website to place a refill order or call Universal
Drugstore directly and speak to our team to place an order via the phone.

### What is the maximum quantity of medication I can purchase on Universal Drugstore?

Customers can typically purchase & import up to a 3-month supply of each medication, provided they
have a valid prescription for that quantity.

### Are generic medications available on Universal Drugstore?

Yes, Universal Drugstore offers over 4,000 medications, many being generic equivalents of brand-name
medications.

### Do you offer discounts or promotions on Universal Drugstore?

Universal Drugstore offers many savings programs for our customers. This includes seasonal
promotions, a loyalty program to earn points and save on your next purchase, a referral program and
more.

### Do you offer automatic refills on Universal Drugstore?

Yes, Universal Drugstore has a seemless refill program through our website, email or phone, to
ensure all customers can get their refilled medication on time.

### Can I use my insurance to pay for medications on Universal Drugstore?

## Your questions, answered

### Where does Universal Drugstore ship to, and how long does delivery take?

We ship to all destinations within the United States (including Alaska and Hawaii), as well as
internationally. Orders over $100 shipping within the U.S. qualify for free shipping; orders under
$100 have a flat $7 USD shipping fee. International orders outside the U.S. have a flat-rate
shipping fee of $19.95 USD.

Estimated delivery times are approximately 2 weeks for U.S. and Canada, and approximately 4 weeks
for international orders. Delivery times may vary based on location, customs clearance, and other
factors beyond our control.

### Is a prescription required to order medications on Universal Drugstore?

At Universal Drugstore, you’ll need to provide a valid prescription from a licensed medical
professional to purchase prescription medications. Our pharmacy team carefully verifies all
prescriptions before processing any orders. If you have questions about your prescription, feel free
to reach out to our customer support team, and we’ll guide you through the process.

### How do I submit my prescription on Universal Drugstore?

To submit your prescription at Universal Drugstore, simply upload it securely during checkout or
email it to our dedicated prescription service. Our licensed pharmacists will review and validate
the prescription before fulfilling your order.

### What payment methods are accepted by Universal Drugstore?

Universal Drugstore accepts a variety of secure payment options to make ordering prescriptions safe
and convenient. We currently accept Visa, Mastercard, international money orders, and eChecks
(electronic checks).

An eCheck, or electronic check, allows you to pay directly from your bank account through a secure
digital process. This method is facilitated via the Automated Clearing House (ACH) network, offering
a reliable alternative to traditional paper checks.

All transactions are processed securely, and our team is here to support you in choosing the best
payment method for your needs.

### How do I place a refill order on Universal Drugstore?

You can log in to your account on the pharmacy's website to place a refill order or call Universal
Drugstore directly and speak to our team to place an order via the phone.

### What is the maximum quantity of medication I can purchase on Universal Drugstore?

Customers can typically purchase & import up to a 3-month supply of each medication, provided they
have a valid prescription for that quantity.

### Are generic medications available on Universal Drugstore?

Yes, Universal Drugstore offers over 4,000 medications, many being generic equivalents of brand-name
medications.

### Do you offer discounts or promotions on Universal Drugstore?

Universal Drugstore offers many savings programs for our customers. This includes seasonal
promotions, a loyalty program to earn points and save on your next purchase, a referral program and
more.

### Do you offer automatic refills on Universal Drugstore?

Yes, Universal Drugstore has a seemless refill program through our website, email or phone, to
ensure all customers can get their refilled medication on time.

### Can I use my insurance to pay for medications on Universal Drugstore?

manage appropriately.

## MALES

**Hyperglycemia and an increased risk of developing diabetes** have been reported in men receiving
GnRH agonists. Monitor blood glucose levels and manage according to current clinical practice.

**Increased risk of myocardial infarction, sudden cardiac death and stroke** has been reported in
association with use of GnRH agonists in men. Patients should be monitored for cardiovascular
disease and be managed according to current clinical practice.

**Androgen deprivation therapy may prolong the QT interval.** Consider risks and benefits.

## ADVERSE REACTIONS

**In men, the most common adverse reactions** (>10%) include hot flashes, sexual dysfunction,
decreased erections and lower urinary tract symptoms.

**In women, the most common adverse reactions** (>20%) include hot flashes, vaginitis, headache,
emotional lability, decreased libido, sweating, depression, acne, breast atrophy, seborrhea, and
peripheral edema.

To report SUSPECTED ADVERSE REACTIONS, contact the FDA at 1‑800‑FDA‑1088 or
[www.FDA.gov/medwatch][28]. You may also contact TerSera Therapeutics at 1‑844‑334‑4035 or
[medicalinformation@tersera.com][29].

** Please see accompanying Full Prescribing Information for [ZOLADEX 3.6 mg][30] and
[ZOLADEX 10.8 mg][31]. **

## INDICATIONS

ZOLADEX (goserelin implant) is a Gonadotropin Releasing Hormone (GnRH) agonist.

**ZOLADEX 3.6 mg** is indicated for:
* Use in the palliative treatment of advanced breast cancer in pre- and perimenopausal women
* The management of endometriosis
* Use as an endometrial-thinning agent prior to endometrial ablation for dysfunctional uterine
  bleeding

**ZOLADEX 3.6 mg and ZOLADEX 10.8 mg** are indicated for:
* Use in combination with flutamide for the management of locally confined carcinoma of the prostate
* Palliative treatment of advanced carcinoma of the prostate
